title: KS3 History: Causes of the Great War
subtitle: A condensed roadmap and revision sheet for this unit.

topics.title: 1. How did the Franco-Prussian War create a lasting legacy of hatred?
points: **Objective:** To evaluate why the Franco-Prussian War created long-term hatred.
**Key Topics:** A Fragmented Germany, Ems Telegram Provokes War, Prussia', France's Humiliation, Bismarck', Bismarck's Alliance Web, Wilhelm Undoes Bismarck

topics.title: 2. To what extent did the 'Scramble for Africa' increase tension in Europe?
points: **Objective:** To evaluate why the scramble for colonies turned empires into rivals.
**Key Topics:** Imperialism's Global, Empires, Germany's Global, German Ambition Alarms, Germany Tests New Alliance, Kaiser', Kaiser', Europe's

topics.title: 3. Why did a battleship building contest destroy Anglo-German relations?
points: **Objective:** To analyze how the naval arms race heightened tensions between Britain and Germany.
**Key Topics:** British Naval Dominance, Germany's Naval Challenge, British Fear German Navy, Naval Arms Race Begins, Naval Standoff Prepar, Naval Power Shift, Naval Revolution', Dreadnought Arms

topics.title: 4. Did the Alliance System protect Europe or guarantee a global war?
points: **Objective:** To evaluate whether the alliance system provided security or created a dangerous threat.
**Key Topics:** Europe's Alliance System, Europe's Two All, German Fears and War Plans, Europe's Industrial War Machine, Germany's Blank Check, Kaiser's Motives, Germany's Calculated War

topics.title: 5. Why did a single assassination in Sarajevo ignite a World War?
points: **Objective:** To analyze how a wrong turn in Sarajevo triggered a world war.

**Key Topics:** Balkans Ignite Conflict, Empire's Serbian, Ferdinand', A Fateful Wrong Turn, Princip's Fatal, War Erupts Globally, July Crisis: Descent, Cousins' Failed Peace, Military Control Unleashes, Colonies Join World War, Dominoes
